verdict.rationale: Temporal is Workflows-as-Code, not a no-code engine (temporal-docs-11), so an agent can't create or edit a workflow definition through an API call; definitions change through code and Worker deployments with Versioning (temporal-docs-13, temporal-docs-29). What an agent can do programmatically is start and manage executions via the Temporal Client (temporal-docs-32), create Schedules that start workflows (temporal-docs-15), and drive operations through the official CLI (temporal-docs-3, temporal-gh-1). Missing for 10: API-level creation/update of workflow definitions, a documented public REST/OpenAPI surface (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and agent-specific or hands-on evidence of this workflow.
